explanation: Compared against erdosproblems.com/666: for every ε > 0 and large n, must every subgraph of Q_n with ≥ ε n 2^{n-1} edges contain a C_6? The answer is no (Chung; Brouwer–Dejter–Thomassen: Q_n edge-partitions into four C_6-free subgraphs). The statement negates the universal claim, using H ≤ hypercube n (Hamming distance 1 adjacency), the edge threshold ε·n·2^{n-1}, and cycleGraph 6 ⊑ H (subgraph containment). Faithful.
